Somewhat experimental optimisation pass:
Tattoo textures are compressed and generate mipmaps. Reduces a tattooed player's cost from +8.4mb in ram and +8.4mb in vram to +2mb (just in vram) compared to non-tattooed players

Zooming with scroll wheel whilst using the 3p orbit cam (holding alt in 3p) now consumes all scroll wheel input

Setup 3p attach anims
Beancan, bee, smoke, supply signal and flashbang now use the grenade animation subsystem

Fix attached grenades having a delay until becoming visible
Attached grenades are visible once a "attach_reveal" viewmodel anim event fires
If the event happens before the actual grenade is spawned, show a predicted attached grenade until the real one spawns 
If the actual grenade is spawned before the event, hide the actual grenade until we get that event
